import { InvoiceNotFoundError } from '#modules/billing/errors/invoice-not-found-error'
import type { IInvoicesRepository } from '#modules/billing/repositories/invoices-repository'

export interface InvoiceResult {
  id: string
  total: number
}

export class GetInvoiceUseCase {
  constructor(private readonly repository: IInvoicesRepository) {}

  async execute(invoiceId: string, userId: string): Promise<InvoiceResult> {
    const invoice = await this.repository.findById(invoiceId)
    if (invoice === null) throw new InvoiceNotFoundError()

    return { id: invoice.id, total: invoice.total }
  }
}
